name: Kawamata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kawamata town emblem in blue: a disc with a pointed top crossed by a diagonal stroke, enclosing a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kawamata, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 October 1965.

features.role: Kawamata town emblem — a disc with a pointed top crossed by a diagonal stroke, enclosing a small disc
